hypotheses.H0_hybrid_bases_transfer: Every fixed-rank hybrid is fit only on discovery CE routes and evaluated on replication routes.
hypotheses.H1_two_context_coordinates_are_sufficien: The two-weight plus two-context rank-four hybrid reaches at least 90% of CE-optimal replication fidelity in at least twelve layers.
hypotheses.H2_one_context_coordinate_is_not_general: The three-weight plus one-context hybrid reaches 95% of CE-optimal fidelity in fewer than twelve layers.
hypotheses.H3_early_ce_novelty_requires_context_coo: At least three of L1/L2/L4/L5 require two or more context-fitted coordinates to reach 95% of CE-optimal fidelity.
hypotheses.H4_context_correction_improves_static_we: Adding one context-fitted coordinate improves replication fidelity over pure weights by at least 0.05 in at least twelve layers.
